python-return.explanation: return sends the value to the caller and ends this call. print displays a value but does not replace returning it.

python-mixed.explanation: Two entries are True. Count completed habits, not every entry in the list.

python-empty.explanation: With no entries, the loop has nothing to count. The starting count of zero is also the result.

python-return-position.explanation: return ends the function immediately. Place it after the loop so all entries can contribute to the result.
